author: Kathleen
body: Katie was a big help in thinking about our current lifestyle, what we were going to get as hand-me-downs, and things that you just don't think about as a first time parent, and how all those things impacted what we actually needed for baby. Katie had a really great ability of making recommendations, but not making us feel like we HAVE to take them. This also helped me feel more confident when I got lots of opinions from others!
